newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIUM TO KILL 15,000 SWINE-FEVER PIGS.
newsitem.headline: BELGIUM TO KILL 15,000 SWINE-FEVER PIGS.

text.p: Belgium plans to kill 15,000 pigs following a swine fever outbreak in the north of the country, the Agriculture Ministry said on Wednesday.

A ministry spokeswoman told Reuters officials will focus mainly on pigs from farms which had been in contact with the pig farm in Bocholt, near the Dutch border, where swine fever was reported on Tuesday.
Belgium, a large producer of pork-based meat products, has about seven million pigs.
